one_month_reasoning: Inside Oct 2-31: (1) September production/operations update, expected mid-October (August's came Sept 17) - likely shows self-mining hashrate ~80+ EH/s, more BTC mined on higher hashprice and AI-cloud/Tydal build progress; mostly known, mild positive. (2) Bitcoin itself: BTC ~$83.5K with hashprice up ~43% since July; BTDR is a high-beta miner so BTC direction dominates. (3) Possible Tydal debt financing announcement (~$500M capex) - non-dilutive debt would be +, a convert/equity raise -. Q3 earnings are expected Nov 9-18, outside the window. No strong edge, so the ladder is close to symmetric around $10.6 at ~30% monthly vol (108%/3.5), with a tiny downward median tilt for financing/dilution risk.

fair_value.method: Blend of a consolidated DCF ($5.07; WACC 12%, g 3%, EBITDA margin 30%->45%, capex $900M in 2027) at 40% and a SOTP ($6.97; Tydal NPV $1.41B, AI capacity/ARR $0.49B, powered-land option $0.77B, mining $0.75B, net debt $1.15B, 324.6M diluted shares) at 60% = $6.21.

methods.name: DCF
methods.inputs: Consolidated unlevered DCF, 2027-31 explicit + terminal. EV at Oct-2027 ~$3.0B less horizon net debt ~$1.15B (2032 converts treated as equity) over 324.6M diluted shares = $5.07 (sensitivity: WACC 11% $6.46, 12.5% $4.49, 13.5% $3.50).

5.3% + beta 2.0 x 5% ERP; beta judgment from 108% realized vol given in the brief.

methods.name: SOTP
methods.inputs: At Oct-2027: Tydal colocation NPV $1.41B + contracted Malaysia AI capacity (A102 9.5 MW + A202 65.1 MW) at $3M/MW $0.225B + existing AI cloud ARR $86M x 3 $0.26B + powered-land conversion option ~1,275 MW x $0.6M/MW $0.765B + mining/SEALMINER $0.75B (~2.5x run-rate mining EBITDA ~$300M) = EV $3.41B; less net debt $1.15B; / 324.6M shares = $6.97.

inputs_detail.value: 121 IT MW, $4.7B over 16y, ~$202/kW-mo avg, 3% escalator, ~90% NOI

inputs_detail.derivation: Starting rent ~$160/kW-mo (avg $202 / 1.26 escalator factor) -> $232M yr1, NOI 90% = $209M, ~$180M after tax; growing annuity 16y at 10% = $1.67B; less 25% x $434M PV of years 11-16 for Volta's no-fee year-10 termination; 10% haircut for tenant credit (Volta founded Jan-2026, its Anthropic offtake is 6 years; $1.3B LCs backstop).
Peer EV/contracted MW $4-18M gross (insights4vc); net of unfunded build capex use $3M/MW.
GPU cloud is capital-intensive and short-duration vs colocation; neocloud comps (Volta $2.4B valuation on $10B offtake) suggest low single-digit revenue multiples.

1,752 MW online less Tydal 175 MW and ~300 MW non-US/Norway sites; uncontracted power valued well below contracted peer levels (CORZ ~$4M/MW, HUT ~$6.9M/MW) given conversion capex and leasing uncertainty.
Q2 adj EBITDA $31.1M + ~$69M/qtr from hashprice $28->$39.7 and hashrate 73->79.9 EH/s, minus non-mining/overhead; 2.5x multiple reflects April-2028 halving.
Same as DCF.

bear.story: BTC retraces toward $60K (hashprice back to the ~$28 July low), mining turns cash-negative again, Tydal financing comes as dilutive convert/equity or Volta tenant credit wobbles; net debt ~$1.2B weighs on a ~$2.5B EV.

base.story: Tydal Phase 1/2 deliver Dec-26/Mar-27 and rent starts, A102 energizes, AI cloud ARR climbs past $150M; mining roughly breakeven-plus at ~$40 hashprice; continued dilution offsets progress so the stock sits near today's level, above my fundamental value on AI optionality.

bull.story: A second hyperscale/neocloud colocation lease on US power (Rockdale 563 MW or Clarington) at peer-like $2M+/MW/yr, BTC >$110K and SEALMINER external sales; market re-rates toward the $20-25 sell-side targets.

thesis_break_reason: Below ~$5.30 (half of today, near the bear case and below the 52-week low $6.92) the market would be pricing a fundamental failure - Tydal delay or Volta default/renegotiation, inability to finance the ~$500M build except via heavy dilution, or a covenant/related-party debt problem - rather than ordinary BTC-beta volatility.

Norway A401 (42.7 MW), Tennessee A601 (55 MW, Oct-27) energization
Bitcoin price / hashprice; approaching April-2028 halving

key_uncertainties: Bitcoin price and hashprice (mining is still most of revenue)
Credit quality of Volta Infra (founded Jan-2026) and its 6-year Anthropic offtake vs a 16-year lease with year-10 termination right
How the ~$500M Tydal build and GPU capex are financed (dilution vs debt) on top of ~$1.8B existing debt incl. $633M related-party
Whether Bitdeer lands further hyperscale colocation leases on its ~1.75 GW online power like peers (HUT, WULF, CIFR, IREN)
SEALMINER competitiveness vs Bitmain S23 and whether external chip sales become material
April-2028 halving priced in during the horizon
reasoning: Industry lane: the value chain says Bitdeer's power is worth more as AI capacity than as hashrate - its own Tydal deal ($202/kW-mo, ~90% NOI) sits within peer economics (~$2M+/MW/yr AI vs ~$0.5M/MW mining; peers' contracted EV/MW $4-18M), and the end customer is reportedly Anthropic via Volta, though Volta is a 7-month-old intermediary with a 6-year offtake and a year-10 walk right. Mining economics improved sharply (hashprice ~$28 -> ~$40 since July as BTC rose ~38% and difficulty only ~6%; network hashrate flat ~950-966 EH/s), and SEALMINER A4 (9.45 J/TH) is at parity with Bitmain's best, but external chip sales are negligible ($0.4M in Q2). Fundamentals: Q2 revenue $228.8M, gross loss, adj EBITDA $31M, net debt ~$1.12B, ~272M basic shares plus in-the-money 2032 converts. My DCF (WACC 12% with a 5.3% 10Y) gives ~$5 and SOTP ~$7; blended fair value $6.21, below the $10.64 price and far below sell-side ($21.8-24 avg). I do not forecast full convergence to fair value in 12 months: the stock trades on AI-lease narrative and BTC beta, with 108% realized vol. I set a lognormal-ish distribution with median ~$9.6 (modest negative drift from valuation gap and dilution) and ~88% annualized vol, consistent with bear $4.5 (30%) / base $10 (45%) / bull $20 (25%), mean ~$10.9. One-month ladder is near-symmetric since earnings fall outside the window.
